author: ankushindaniil
content: Thanks! Reproduced it: your 128s keccak verifier (PR #8 @ b663f2b7) inside a VERIFY frame on Nethermind master comes out at 362–393k, median ~374k, over 24 sigs (your 4 KATs + 20 fresh). Forge gives 355–385k, so it matches your ~360k. Calldata for the ~8 KB sig is on top of that (~126k). That puts it over the 300k verify cap, so it wouldn't get into the public mempool as-is. For comparison, SHA2-128-24 is 145–155k in the same harness. Would a 2^24-signature variant like SHA2-128-24 work for your use case? It fits under the cap.
